time_scoring.correctness_gate: Time efficiency cannot compensate for failed correctness or missing required deliverables.

rating_anchors.2: Partially meets requirements; material gaps remain
rating_anchors.3: Meets core requirements with minor issues
rating_anchors.4: Fully meets requirements with strong, well-supported evidence

guardrails: Time cannot compensate for failed correctness.
Do not reward raw speed as a proxy for skill.
Human review is required for reasoning and context-dependent quality.
Missing evidence and infrastructure failures must be handled separately from candidate performance.
